main_text.p: Verùm, Máno, ex quodam vsu loquendi, quanuis sit generis muliebris, definit tamen, quû singularis est num. in O, vt Máno, ex quo consequitur in plur. definere in I, vt Máni.
main_text.head: DE NOMINVM DECLINATIONE.
main_text.p: VAnquam (vt suprà monuimus, quum de articulorum declinatio-ne ageremus) sermo Italic⁹ casus & flexus nominum, cuiusmodi in Latina & Græca liguis esse videtur, nō agnoscat: nihilominus haud omnē inflexionē respuit.

page.notes: The declension diagram uses braces; the lines are transcribed as outline rows. Greek word "Oréccchia" in the diagram reads as printed. Marked doubtful: "Italic⁹" and "liguis" are as printed.
